# Copilot Instructions

## Environment

Always use the `forecast_evaluation` conda environment when running terminal commands (e.g. `conda activate forecast_evaluation` before running tests, installing packages, or executing scripts).

## Code Style
Always run `ruff format` and `ruff check --fix` after modifying code.

## instructions
* Never commit. 
* Never modify the assert of a test without asking first.
* Never delete or skip tests without asking first.
* Write british english.
